en.name: Scheduling
en.description: Book conversations, reviews and consultations. Set event types, weekly availability and date overrides, choose times across time zones, manage or cancel bookings and export calendars with your agents.

zh.name: 日程预约
zh.description: 安排交流、评审和咨询：设置预约类型、每周可用时间与例外日期，按时区选择时段、填写信息，管理或取消预约，导出日历；和 agent 共用一份日程。
